title: First Lesson: Fetch
intro_lines: Puck worries a splintered oar handle, tail going.
You whistle.
It tilts its head, unimpressed. Fetch, then.

choices.label: Throw the oar into the shallows

outcomes.text: Puck belly-flops after it and drags it back, insufferably proud.
It brings back a rotten coconut instead. Close enough for a first try.
It misjudges a wave, tumbles, and sulks in the foam until you apologise.

choices.label: Bribe it with fish scraps

outcomes.text: The bargain holds. Puck learns fast when it is being paid.
It eats the bribe, then ignores the oar entirely and sleeps.

choices.label: Skip the lesson, let it nap

outcomes.text: It sleeps against your boot. Trust grows in the quiet.
You both lose the afternoon to the heat and learn nothing.

history_note: Alexander Selkirk tamed feral kid goats on Juan Fernández for milk and company, the same patient bribery that turns a wild animal into a working partner.

title: The Buried Locker
intro_lines: Puck's nose drops.
It digs with both forefeet.
Sand sprays your shins. It will not be stopped.

choices.label: Dig beside it

outcomes.text: A tarred bundle: sailcloth, a flint striker, a dead man's boots.
Older bones. A turtle's ribs, picked clean, and a shell worth keeping.
You strike rusted iron and open your palm on it.

choices.label: Let Puck dig alone, hands off

outcomes.text: It presents a pearl as though it were a fish head, all pride.
It hoards the find under the floorboards. Yours, apparently, not.

choices.label: Call it off, the bank is unstable

outcomes.text: The dune caves where you stood. Puck presses hard to your leg.
It obeys, resentfully, then digs three fresh holes out of spite.

history_note: Pedro Serrano used shells as rain-catchers and fuel on Serrana Bank, teaching himself to wring use from whatever the tide buried.

title: Bad Fish
intro_lines: Puck vomits seawater and half-digested fish.
Then it curls tight and will not look at you.
The fish that did it was silver, not scaled.

choices.label: Boil herbs into a bitter mash

outcomes.text: It laps the mash, shivers once, and sleeps it off by noon.
It refuses it hot, takes it cold, and recovers slowly and grudgingly.
It heaves the mash back up. You sit the whole night out with it.

choices.label: Force freshwater down it, a sip

outcomes.text: Small sips, then a long drink. Colour comes back to its flanks.
Too fast. It brings the water straight back up on your boots.

choices.label: Let it ride it out. Watch all night

outcomes.text: By dawn it is on its feet, thinner and warier, and follows you closely.
It worsens. You hold its head clear of the sick and count breaths.
It goes still a long moment, then breathes. You do not sleep at all.

history_note: Ciguatera from large reef predators is not destroyed by cooking, so a silver barracuda can poison a companion that eats better than you do.

title: The Crab It Could Not Leave
intro_lines: Puck freezes, quivering, fixed on a crab.
The crab is huge and entirely unbothered.
It bolts before you can grab the harness.

choices.label: Chase it into the rocks

outcomes.text: You corner both. Puck gets the crab, you get the claw and the meat.
The crab escapes. Puck slices a forefoot open on the coral doing it.
You slip in the surf and go down hard on the wet rock.

choices.label: Whistle it back and sit still

outcomes.text: It returns at last, sulking, and leans its whole weight on your shin.
The crab wanders to you instead. Dinner, rudely delivered.
It ignores you for an hour. The crab wins and you look foolish.

choices.label: Bait it with a shell

outcomes.text: Puck learns the trick itself: bait, wait, pounce. A hunter is made.
It eats the bait and abandons the hunt entirely, well fed and useless.

history_note: Coconut crabs climb palms and crush with claws measured near 3,300 newtons, so a companion that chases one is not merely playing.

title: Something on the Treeline
intro_lines: Puck's low rasp wakes you before the sound does.
Something is walking the treeline, unhurried.
Your blade is under the cot. You reach slowly.

choices.label: Send Puck to circle behind it

outcomes.text: It flushes a UTC scout, who runs rather than fight alone in the rain.
It flushes a boar instead. The boar charges straight through your fire.
Puck is gone too long. You find it shaking in the wet ferns.

choices.label: Keep Puck close and build the fire

outcomes.text: Whatever it was decides your fire is not worth the trouble.
It circles twice more, then goes. You do not sleep again.
A shape breaks cover: a UTC scout, who marks your camp and leaves.

choices.label: Go out and meet it alone

outcomes.text: A half-drowned sailor, unarmed. You give him water and a fire.
Nothing out there but a torn sail snapping on a stake.
A boar at close quarters. Puck hits it and buys you one breath.

history_note: Alexander Selkirk tamed feral cats after rats gnawed his feet at night, keeping them as sentinels as much as companions.

title: The Scent Line
intro_lines: Puck works a scent line through the ferns.
Not a wild smell.
Something carried.

choices.label: Follow where it leads

outcomes.text: A poacher's snare line, and a pig still warm in the wire.
A tideborn blind, empty, marked with shells. A scout watches, then is gone.
The trail ends at a wallow. The boar is very much at home.

choices.label: Lift Puck and back away downwind

outcomes.text: You withdraw unseen. Puck trembles, then slowly relaxes against you.
Something follows you half the way back to the outpost.

choices.label: Put Puck on a lead and press on

outcomes.text: Leashed, it works the trail cleaner, nose down, no wasted steps.
It fights the rope the whole way and you learn nothing at all.

history_note: Feral pigs left by sailors root up ground and eat crab juveniles and eggs, so their wallows and runs are the clearest trails any island offers.

title: The Hand in the Sand
intro_lines: Puck digs at something under a scrap of canvas.
Not a shell.
The sand there is the wrong shape.

choices.label: Dig. Get it out.

outcomes.text: A hand. Then an arm. The man under the canvas is breathing.
Canvas, wet sand, then a salt-crusted wrist that moves when you touch it.

choices.label: Drag Puck off and mark the spot

outcomes.text: You stake the canvas down and haul Puck home, snarling at your heel.
It fights the harness the whole way back to camp and sleeps facing away.

history_note: On Serrana Bank a second castaway reached Pedro Serrano after years alone, and the two men quarrelled before they made peace, the sea rarely sending help in a shape you want.

title: Diving for Supper
intro_lines: Puck porpoises over the reef crest, hunting.
It dives.
Bubbles, then nothing, then bubbles.

choices.label: Let it hunt the drop-off

outcomes.text: It hauls up a grouper bigger than its own head and drops it at your feet.
It surfaces with a moray still clamped to its flank.
A reef shark takes the fish out of its jaws and leaves a graze.

choices.label: Call it in before the grey shape returns

outcomes.text: It comes grudging, with two small fish and a rag of net tangled on it.
It ignores you until the shark has passed. Your nerves pay for it.

choices.label: Wade out and fish it yourself

outcomes.text: You spear two. Puck herds them into the shallows and holds them.
You gash a shin open on coral and come back with nothing.

history_note: Reef sharks are drawn by blood and thrashing in the shallows, so a companion diving with a struggling fish is ringing a bell underwater.

title: Salt in the Wound
intro_lines: He is UTC by his coat.
Pressed, not willing.
His hands are bound with his own belt.

choices.label: Cut him loose and give him water

outcomes.text: Pressed off a merchantman. He knows where UTC careens and draws it for you.
He drinks, thanks you, and is gone before dawn. So is your flint.
He drinks, then reaches for your knife. Puck gets to his wrist first.

choices.label: Take his coat and boots, leave the belt

outcomes.text: You walk away with good boots, a warm coat and a bad feeling.
He shouts a ship's name after you. Puck growls at the trees all day.
He works the belt loose and comes at your back. Puck is already turning.

choices.label: Leave water within reach and go

outcomes.text: He is free by nightfall. You never learn his name or his ship.
He is dead by morning. Puck will not leave the spot and will not eat.

history_note: Pirate articles condemned offenders to marooning with a gun, a bottle of water and a bottle of powder, a sentence the sea knows well.

title: What the Tide Left
intro_lines: Puck is gone from the cot.
You find it digging.
The canvas is shredded. Whatever is under it is metal.

choices.label: Open it

outcomes.text: A UTC dark-binding crystal in an iron cage. Puck will not come near it.
A tideborn reliquary, sealed with coral. It hums when you lift it.
Powder, damp and useless, in a crate that stinks of tar and old water.

choices.label: Bury it deeper, Puck hugged

outcomes.text: You cover it and sleep badly. Puck does not dig there again.
It is back at the hole by noon. So, inevitably, are you.

choices.label: Haul it to the water and let it go

outcomes.text: It slides under the surf and does not come back. Puck watches it go.
The rope parts and the crate stays. Puck stares at the water a while.

history_note: Tromelin's castaways kept a single fire alive fifteen years on wreck timber and driftwood and salvaged lead basins for water, wreckage on a beach never being only wreckage.

title: The Yelp on the Cliff
intro_lines: You point Puck up the cliff path.
It goes.
Ten minutes. Then a yelp, cut short.

choices.label: Go down after it

outcomes.text: A crevice, a dropped fish, and Puck, wedged and furious with you.
You find it cornered in the rocks by something with too many limbs.
The yelp was a gull. Puck is perfectly fine and smug about it.

choices.label: Wait and whistle

outcomes.text: It comes up the path with a cut foot and a stolen egg in its mouth.
Nothing. You whistle until your throat is raw and the fog thickens.

choices.label: Send down a rope line

outcomes.text: It bites the rope and you haul it up, sodden, shaking and grateful.
It tangles itself, panics, and you nearly lose the rope and your grip.

history_note: Tromelin's castaways fed on sooty tern colonies numbering tens of thousands, which is why a cliff full of birds is worth a dangerous climb.

title: Goat Kid Jealousy
intro_lines: Tide-Puck snaps at a tamed goat kid.
The kid bleats; Puck guards his bowl.

choices.label: Separate bowls, train both

outcomes.text: Puck learns to share; kid follows you.
Puck sulks for a day, then recovers.

choices.label: Scold Puck, reward kid

outcomes.text: Puck withdraws; kid grows bold.
Puck obeys but sulks at night.

history_note: Selkirk tamed kid goats for milk and company on Juan Fernandez.

title: Puck Turns on the Kid
intro_lines: Puck corners the goat kid at dawn.
Ears flat; snarling low.

choices.label: Intervene, feed Puck first

outcomes.text: Puck stands down; kid spared.
Kid bolts; Puck chases but stops.

choices.label: Let them settle it

outcomes.text: Kid wins respect; Puck backs off.
Kid injured; you treat the wound.

history_note: Alexander Selkirk ran down feral goats on foot on Juan Fernandez and tamed kids for milk and company.

title: Rats in the Larder
intro_lines: Rats gnaw through your stores.
Puck watches, uninterested.

choices.label: Set Puck on the rats

outcomes.text: Puck clears the larder in a night.
Puck plays, rats scatter deeper.

choices.label: Trap and bait yourself

outcomes.text: You catch six; stores saved.
Trap springs empty; rats return.

history_note: Rats gnawed Alexander Selkirk's feet as he slept until he tamed feral cats to keep them off.

title: Parrot Learns a Word
intro_lines: A scarlet parrot lands on your shoulder.
It cocks its head, listening.

choices.label: Teach it 'UTC ship'

outcomes.text: It squawks it at passing sails.
It only says 'food' instead.

choices.label: Feed and release it

outcomes.text: It returns with a shiny shell.
It flies off, never returns.

history_note: Parrots mimic speech and were sold in pirate havens.

title: Injured Gull
intro_lines: A gull with a broken wing lies in surf.
Puck sniffs, wary of its beak.

choices.label: Splint and cage it

outcomes.text: It heals; later circles your camp.
It pecks free and escapes injured.

choices.label: Leave it to the crabs

outcomes.text: Crabs take it; Puck sulks all day.
It dies; Puck eats it anyway.

history_note: Tromelin castaways ate sooty terns and seabirds by the colony.

title: Puck Refuses a Command
intro_lines: You strike Puck for eating a coil.
He cowers; refuses your whistle.

choices.label: Apologise, offer food

outcomes.text: Puck forgives; tail wags again.
He eats but keeps distance.

choices.label: Force the command

outcomes.text: Puck obeys, then hides for hours.
He snaps; you lose a finger's skin.

history_note: Companion animals reduced despair for Selkirk and Ada Blackjack.

title: Coconut Crab Theft
intro_lines: A coconut crab steals your knife.
Puck tracks it into the rocks.

choices.label: Follow Puck, retrieve knife

outcomes.text: Puck corners it; knife recovered.
Claw pinches Puck's nose; retreat.

choices.label: Bribe with coconut

outcomes.text: Crab drops knife, takes coconut.
It ignores you, vanishes seaward.

history_note: Coconut crabs scavenge and steal shiny objects.

title: Training Breakthrough
intro_lines: Puck drags a fish to your feet.
He waits, tail stiff, for praise.

choices.label: Reward and name the trick

outcomes.text: Puck learns 'fetch fish' reliably.
He eats it before you can praise.

choices.label: Ignore, demand more

outcomes.text: Puck tries again, succeeds.
Puck drops the trick, confused.

history_note: Selkirk read the Bible aloud to keep his speech.

title: Puck Warns of Boar
intro_lines: Puck freezes, hackles raised.
A boar grunts in the ferns.

choices.label: Retreat with Puck

outcomes.text: You slip away; boar loses interest.
Boar charges; Puck bites its ear.

choices.label: Stand ground, throw stones

outcomes.text: Boar flees; you gather tusks.
Boar gores your leg; Puck drags you out.

history_note: Feral boar charge when cornered or with piglets.

title: Tide-Puck Finds Fresh Water
intro_lines: Puck scratches at wet sand.
A seep pools behind the dune.

choices.label: Dig and collect water

outcomes.text: You fill two skins; Puck drinks first.
Sand collapses; water turns brackish.

choices.label: Mark spot, return later

outcomes.text: Later you find a full pool.
Tide washes it out; spot lost.

history_note: Digging behind the dune line can reach a brackish lens.

title: Puck's Night Watch
intro_lines: Puck won't sleep; stares at surf.
A shape moves in the fog.

choices.label: Trust Puck, stay alert

outcomes.text: Tideborn scout passes; Puck silent.
UTC patrol; you hide in time.

choices.label: Wake the camp, arm up

outcomes.text: False alarm; sleep lost, morale drops.
You catch a thief at the stores.

history_note: Selkirk hid from Spanish ships and waited for English.

title: First Dive for Pearls
intro_lines: Tide-Puck circles the reef drop-off.
Moonlight shafts through thirty feet of water.

choices.label: Send Tide-Puck down with a weighted net

outcomes.text: Tide-Puck returns with a net heavy with pearl oysters — six perfect specimens.
Tide-Puck surfaces coughing — a moray bit his flank. One pearl, a nasty wound.
The current seized him. Tide-Puck drags himself ashore, net empty, eyes wide with fear.

choices.label: Dive together — you hold the line, he

outcomes.text: Teamwork pays. Thirty shells, twelve pearls. Tide-Puck nuzzles your hand, proud.
Shark shadow passes. You both bolt for the surface — half the catch lost.
Rope snags on coral. You cut it free, but Tide-Puck panics — bolts for deep water.

choices.label: Wait for low tide — wade the flats

outcomes.text: Patient work. Two dozen oysters, three pearls. Tide-Puck learns the rhythm of the flats.
Stonefish spine in your heel. Tide-Puck drags you to shore, whining. Fever takes hold.
Tide turns faster than expected. Basket lost. Tide-Puck retrieves it — empty.

history_note: Pearl diving on breath-hold was practised by Bajau divers and Caribbean free-divers; oyster beds at 10–15 m yield 1–2% pearl-bearing shells (Frontiers Mar. Sci. 2019).

title: The Pearl's Price
intro_lines: Tide-Puck refuses his fish ration.
He paws at a pearl in your palm, then at his own flank.
The wound — or the fear — has settled deeper than skin.

choices.label: Trade the best pearl to Silas for herbs

outcomes.text: Silas grunts, mixes a poultice. Tide-Puck drinks it, sleeps twelve hours, wakes hungry.
Rum was watered. Poultice draws pus but leaves a limp. Tide-Puck favours the leg.
Silas pockets the pearl, gives you seawater in a bottle. Tide-Puck growls at him.

choices.label: Let Tide-Puck chew mangrove bark — old

outcomes.text: Bark tannins close the wound. Tide-Puck's eyes clear. He brings you a crab next dawn.
Bark helps the flesh, not the fright. Tide-Puck shakes at the sight of deep water.
Mangrove sap blisters his tongue. He retches, hides in the jungle for a day.

choices.label: Press on — take him spear-fishing

outcomes.text: He strikes a grouper clean. The kill steadies him. Bond deepens — he watches your back now.
He freezes at the drop-off. You spear the fish alone. He watches, ashamed.
Barracuda hits your stringer. Tide-Puck intercepts — takes the teeth meant for you.

history_note: Sailors used mangrove bark tannins for wound wash (RMG); rum-and-herb poultices were standard ship's medicine (Pirate Surgeon's Journal).

title: Pearl Memory
intro_lines: Weeks later, Tide-Puck stops at the same reef.
He does not dive — he points.
A single giant clam gapes.

choices.label: Harvest it — Tideborn relics resonate

outcomes.text: The pearl hums in your pack. That night, Tideborn scouts leave a conch-shell offering at the gate.
Clam snaps shut on your knife. Pearl lost, blade snapped. Tide-Puck retrieves the handle.
UTC launch appears on the horizon — someone saw the flash. Run.

choices.label: Leave it — Tide-Puck remembers

outcomes.text: Tide-Puck circles the clam once, then leads you to a sunken crate: iron, sailcloth, a chart fragment.
A free pirate diver beats you to it. He salutes with the pearl. "Next round's on me."
Storm surge buries the site. Nothing remains but Tide-Puck's quiet certainty.

choices.label: Crack it open on the spot — eat

outcomes.text: Meat feeds the camp for two days. Pearl funds a careening. Tide-Puck gets first bite.
Ciguatera in the clam's gut. You and Tide-Puck both convulse — hot/cold reversal for days.
Pearl was a UTC tracker — dark crystal inside. Patrol homes in on your outpost that night.

history_note: Giant clams (Tridacna) host symbiotic algae; large specimens exceed 1 m and 200 kg. Ciguatera bioaccumulates in reef filter-feeders (Cleveland Clinic).

title: Blood in the Scuppers
intro_lines: UTC cutter runs aground on the hidden shoal.
Boarding pikes flash in lantern light.
Tide-Puck launches from the shadows — not fleeing, hunting.

choices.label: Fight beside him — cutlass and claw

outcomes.text: You drop the officer; Tide-Puck guts the bosun. Survivors swim for it. Bond forged in blood.
Pike catches your thigh. Tide-Puck drags you behind a crate, holds the line until sailors rally.
Too many. You're both pinned. Silas's gunners save you — but Tide-Puck is taken, caged.

choices.label: Order Tide-Puck to harass — you man

outcomes.text: Grapeshot rakes the deck. Tide-Puck hamstrings three men in the smoke. Cutter strikes colours.
Gun misfires. Tide-Puck buys time with his life — a bayonet in his ribs. You drag him clear.
UTC officer shoots Tide-Puck mid-leap. He falls. You execute the officer. No quarter.

choices.label: Light the signal fire — call Silas's

outcomes.text: Sailors descend like wraiths. UTC breaks. Tide-Puck herds prisoners — proud, unscratched.
Fire draws a second UTC launch. Tide-Puck vanishes into the surf — returns at dawn with a UTC codebook.
Rain douses the fire. Tide-Puck fights alone on the beach. You find him at dawn, alive, surrounded by dead.

history_note: Pirate swivel guns loaded grapeshot for anti-personnel work; boarding actions often decided by close-quarters ferocity (Johnson 1724).

title: The Guardian's Lesson
intro_lines: Tide-Puck paces the palisade at midnight.
He stops, sniffs, growls low — nothing visible.
Silas's newest sailor, a boy named Finn, sleeps by the fire.

choices.label: Trust the instinct — post Finn on watch

outcomes.text: Finn spots UTC marines crawling through mangroves. Alarm raised. Camp survives the night.
Finn falls asleep again. Tide-Puck bites his ankle — the boy screams, alerting the camp anyway.
Tide-Puck was wrong — just a land crab. Finn resents the beast; sailors whisper 'cursed'.

choices.label: Train the pair — drills at dawn

outcomes.text: Two weeks later, Finn and Tide-Puck move as one. The boy laughs when the beast 'speaks' in whistles.
Finn tries to ride Tide-Puck like a horse. Beast throws him — broken arm. Silas frowns.
Finn deserts, stealing a boat. Tide-Puck tracks him to a UTC cutter — returns with the boy's knife.

choices.label: Assign Tide-Puck to guard the stores —

outcomes.text: Tide-Puck catches a monkey thief red-handed. Stores safe. Finn survives a raid unaided — grows hard.
Monkeys swarm the stores. Tide-Puck fights them off but half the flour is scattered. Finn freezes.
Tide-Puck abandons the post to chase a scent. Rats eat the salt. Finn weeps; Silas flogs him.

history_note: Ships' cats and dogs were formal rat-catchers; Royal Navy victualling records list 'cat's meat' allowances (RMG).

title: Standing the Watch
intro_lines: Fog clings to the cliff tops.
Tide-Puck and Finn — now a pair — hold the northern blind.
A horn sounds from the sea. Not UTC. Not pirate.

choices.label: Send them to investigate — you ready

outcomes.text: They return with a Tideborn scout — wounded, bearing a warning: the Abyssal Sovereign wakes.
They find a UTC listening post. Finn copies the cipher; Tide-Puck kills the operator silently.
Finn doesn't return. Tide-Puck drags his body from the surf — throat cut, UTC badge in hand.

choices.label: Go yourself — leave the camp to Silas

outcomes.text: You find a Tideborn ruin entrance. Tide-Puck's bioluminescence keys the door. Relics within.
UTC ambush on the cliff path. You and Tide-Puck fight free — Finn holds the rope for your escape.
The horn was a whale. Fog lifts — you're exposed on the ridge. UTC schooner opens fire.

choices.label: Light the warning beacons — whatever it

outcomes.text: Beacons blaze. Free pirate fleet on the horizon answers — they anchor in your lee. Trade opens.
Beacons draw UTC frigates. You hold them off with shore batteries — but the camp burns.
The horn stops. Silence. Dawn reveals nothing — but Tide-Puck refuses to leave the cliff edge.

history_note: Pirate havens used beacon chains; Île Sainte-Marie's signal fires coordinated careening crews and warned of naval approach (Sailing the Black Flag).

title: Bad Fish, Bad Dreams
intro_lines: You both ate the big grouper Silas caught.
Sweet flesh, firm — a feast.
Midnight: your hands burn like ice.

choices.label: Force coconut water and induced

outcomes.text: Violent purge. You survive the night shaking. Tide-Puck's eyes clear by dawn — weakened, alive.
Tide-Puck aspirates vomit. He rasps for days. You carry him to the reef each dawn to breathe.
Nothing comes up. Toxin binds nerves. You both convulse for a week — nerves permanently crossed.

choices.label: Seek Tideborn healers — they know

outcomes.text: Tideborn scout appears at the tide line. She trades a root paste for a pearl. Fever breaks in hours.
Scout demands the pearl and a favour — sabotage a UTC dark-binding crystal. You agree.
Scout watches you convulse, says nothing. Leaves. You survive — but trust fractures.

choices.label: Ride it out — old sailors say

outcomes.text: Three days of hell. You wake gaunt, hands tingling. Tide-Puck never leaves your side — bond deepened.
Tide-Puck's hind legs fail. You build a litter, haul him to tide pools daily. He recovers — scarred.
You forget fire burns. Badly scarred hands. Tide-Puck learns to fetch, carry, open jars for you.

history_note: Ciguatera from large reef predators (grouper, barracuda) causes hot-cold reversal; not destroyed by cooking (Cleveland Clinic).

title: Storm-Drift
intro_lines: Squall hits the fishing skiff.
Mast snaps.
You wake on an unknown cay — no outpost, no Silas.

choices.label: Follow Tide-Puck inland — he smells

outcomes.text: He leads you to a limestone sinkhole — fresh water, crabs, shelter. A castaway's cache: rusted cutlass, flint.
Water found — but feral boar claim the cay. Tide-Puck distracts them; you climb a palm to escape.
Sinkhole is a UTC dumping ground. Barrels of dark-binding crystals. Tide-Puck growls — they pulse.

choices.label: Build a raft from the skiff wreckage —

outcomes.text: Raft holds. Tide-Puck tows you against the current. Two days later, Silas's signal fire guides you in.
Current too strong. You drift past the islands. Tide-Puck catches flying fish — you survive on raw meat.
Raft disintegrates. You swim the last mile, towing Tide-Puck. He saves you from a reef shark.

choices.label: Climb the highest point — signal

outcomes.text: Free pirate sloop spots the flash. They lift you — captain owes Silas a debt. Passage home.
UTC brig spots you. They take you aboard — not as prisoners, as 'guests'. Tide-Puck rides in a cage.
No one comes. Storm returns. You huddle in a cave, Tide-Puck warming your feet — like Selkirk's cats.

history_note: Alexander Selkirk tamed feral cats for warmth and rat control; Pedro Serrano used seaweed and wreck planks for fire on a waterless cay (RMG, Frontiers 2019).

title: The Wild Kin
intro_lines: Back at the outpost, Tide-Puck stops at the jungle edge.
His hackles rise.
A low whistle answers. Not tame.

choices.label: Let Tide-Puck meet him — kin recognise

outcomes.text: They circle, sniff, touch snouts. The wild one follows you home. Two Mythos now guard the camp.
Wild one bites Tide-Puck — a test. Tide-Puck submits. Wild one leaves, but returns at night to hunt for camp.
Wild one is UTC property — dark-binding collar hidden under mud. He drags Tide-Puck toward the sea.

choices.label: Challenge the wild one — assert

outcomes.text: You and Tide-Puck drive him off. He respects the loss. Weeks later, he returns with a mate — pack forms.
Wild one nearly kills Tide-Puck. You intervene with a spear — wound the wild one. He flees, hatred in his eyes.
Tide-Puck refuses to fight. He lies down. Wild one sniffs, then guards you both through the night.

choices.label: Offer food — buy peace with a trough

outcomes.text: Wild one eats, watches. Next dawn, a pile of pearls at the gate. He vanishes — but the gifts continue.
He takes the fish and Tide-Puck's favourite toy. Returns at dusk with a UTC scout's severed hand.
Poisoned fish — UTC bait. Wild one convulses. Tide-Puck howls. You burn the body. No gifts come.

history_note: Feral goats on Juan Fernández became living larders; Selkirk tamed kids for milk and company (DNB).

title: Scent of Danger
intro_lines: Tide-Puck freezes mid-step.
Nose up.
Ears flat. A scent you cannot smell.

choices.label: Trust him — backtrack and find another

outcomes.text: You circle the ridge. Later, a rockfall thunders down the path you'd have taken. Tide-Puck earns a fish.
Long detour costs daylight. You make camp in the open — mosquitoes feast. Tide-Puck sleeps on your face.
The other path has a UTC ambush. Tide-Puck's warning saved you — but now they know you're near.

choices.label: Press on carefully — send Tide-Puck

outcomes.text: He flushes a stonefish from the sand — you avoid it. He finds a tide-pool cave: pearls, dry shelter.
He signals 'big predator.' You ready spear — a tiger shark in the shallows. You skirt it unseen.
He vanishes. Whistle brings no answer. Hours later he returns — dragging a monkey he killed.

choices.label: Test the air yourself — wet a finger

outcomes.text: Brine, rot, sulphur — volcanic vent ahead. Good for tar, bad for lungs. You harvest tar, retreat.
Gun oil and tobacco — UTC patrol upwind. You ambush them, take their charts. Tide-Puck gets the rum.
Nothing. Wind shifts. Tide-Puck looks at you like you're daft. A coconut falls — misses your head by inches.

history_note: Ships' animals warned of hazards; cats detected gas leaks, dogs sensed storms (RMG).

title: Relic Retriever
intro_lines: Tide-Puck returns from a solo dive.
Not with fish — a coral-encrusted box in his jaws.
The lock bears the Tideborn spiral.

choices.label: Open it now — knowledge is survival

outcomes.text: Inside: a star-chart of the Abyssal Sovereign's migration. And a warning — UTC hunts the birthing grounds.
Dark-binding crystal shard inside. It screams when touched. Tide-Puck howls. You bury it deep.
Trap — gas puffs out. You cough blood for days. Tide-Puck drags you to fresh air. Chart lost.

choices.label: Give it to Silas — he knows buyers

outcomes.text: Silas grins — 'Tideborn tech fetches triple in Sainte-Marie.' Gold, gunpowder, a new sail for the skiff.
Silas's fence is a UTC informant. Patrol hits the outpost that night. You escape — barely.
Silas refuses — 'Some things ain't for sale.' He hides it. Tide-Puck watches the spot, unblinking.

choices.label: Return it to the sea — some debts are

outcomes.text: Tideborn scouts meet you at the reef. They take the box, leave a pearl necklace — and a conch that calls them.
You drop it in the trench. Tide-Puck dives after — returns with a scale the size of a shield. Sovereign's scale.
UTC depth-charges the drop site. Concussion stuns you both. Box destroyed. Tide-Puck's ears ring for weeks.

history_note: Île Sainte-Marie's pirate economy fenced exotic goods; Adam Baldridge traded cattle for guns and iron (Sailing the Black Flag).
